import json, pathlib, subprocess, time, traceback, urllib.request, platform
D=pathlib.Path('/workspace/diagnostics'); D.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
start=time.time(); (D/'preflight-start.json').write_text(json.dumps({'epoch':start,'deadline_epoch':start+180,'platform':platform.platform(),'machine':platform.machine()},indent=2))
cmd=json.loads((D/'recognition-command.json').read_text())
r={'command':cmd,'runtime_exists':pathlib.Path(cmd[0]).exists(),'inherited_exception_log_available':False}
try:
 p=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=10)
 r.update(returncode=p.returncode,output=p.stdout)
except Exception:
 r['exact_current_exception']=traceback.format_exc()
(D/'startup-reproduction.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)); print(json.dumps(r,indent=2))
try:
 req=urllib.request.Request('https://api.github.com/repos/Audiveris/audiveris/releases/latest',headers={'User-Agent':'bounded-audiveris-preflight'})
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=15) as f: release=json.load(f)
 assets=[{'name':a['name'],'url':a['browser_download_url'],'size':a['size']} for a in release.get('assets',[])]
 (D/'audiveris-release.json').write_text(json.dumps({'tag':release.get('tag_name'),'assets':assets},indent=2)); print('RELEASE',release.get('tag_name'),json.dumps(assets))
except Exception: print(traceback.format_exc())
try:
 p=subprocess.run(['apt-get','update','-qq'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=35)
 (D/'apt-update.log').write_text(p.stdout); print('APT_UPDATE',p.returncode,p.stdout[-2000:])
 p=subprocess.run(['apt-cache','policy','openjdk-25-jre-headless','openjdk-21-jre-headless','libfreetype6','libfontconfig1','libgomp1','tesseract-ocr'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=5)
 print(p.stdout)
except Exception: print(traceback.format_exc())
print('PREFLIGHT_ELAPSED',time.time()-start)
PY
